initialInspect.admissionDisposition: Identity and all original isolation/mount/UID/cgroup/network/flags checks required beforestart/success; any mismatch is fatal/unqualified. Cleanup uses separate fresh immutableidentity predicate only.

startAttach.retainedStreams: Actual owned Docker CLI pipes; no inference that outer API EOF is helper EOF.

removeExactOwned.condition: Fresh complete immutable fullCID+exact generatedname+exact imageID+allthree nonce-purpose ownershiplabels match the precreation intent. This authorizes bounded exact-owned removal even when recorded isolation/mount/UID/cgroup/network predicates FAILED. Unknown/foreign/changed immutable identity never authorizes removal.
removeExactOwned.mismatchDisposition: Identity match plus isolation mismatch: forbidstart/success, keep UNQUALIFIED, still attempt fresh exact-owned rm and absence. Identity uncertain/mismatch: no rm; UNKNOWN_ROOT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.

confirmAbsence.acceptedNegativeShape: Original Docker29 exact absence predicate/actual rawstdout+stderr+exit; never exit-code-only

outerStatus: SOURCE-only unchanged180s controller/183s outerproposal; firstphase absolute30 is enforced and cannot consume48s cleanupreserve. No finalcontroller/plan/release or command emitted.
logDriverProposal: none: attached raw streams are sole retained child output, avoiding an unbounded duplicate/proof-budget ambiguity; this is an explicit probe-only operational choice requiring SOURCE/concrete review, not a silent alteration of ordinary-role logging.

phaseTimingRules.startsAt: Original controllerT0 before first staging/admission; no stage-specific timer reset
phaseTimingRules.perStep: Before each file/hash chunk or CLI step recheck first-phase and original lease/controller clocks. R is remaining to earliest applicable first-phase deadline. Refuse when no positive bounded work fits.
phaseTimingRules.cliClamp: For every first-phase CLI with nominalrun<=8s and a single absolute reap<=3s: refuse BEFOREspawn if R<=3s; otherwise run<=min(8s,R-3s), and reapend<=min(stepterminal+3s,phaseDeadline). Freshremaining must be recomputed before eachstep.
phaseTimingRules.stageCompletion: All admission predicates mustcomplete strictlybefore T0+30; otherwise no startAttach, negative/UNKNOWN and exact-owned cleanup. Three8+3 maxima plusstaging are not assumedtofit.
